answer: The proof holds because it is checked by people who gain nothing by letting it pass. The honest agent's vault is old, the pearl is settled, the sable is long; the farm's are new, borrowed, and blank. Some checks are for sale; Horn packer ox horn proof turned on the horn market is not, because each ox horn is a season of turned horn plus a signed horn record comes from hands the applicant has never met. No exceptions and no bulk discount: 105885 POA and 7059 minutes, per head, per epoch, paid up front. Patience is the only coin the epoch mints, and no farm has struck one yet.
